payload.summary: Refined the scaffolded change into a full plan: a per-project snapshot of pending gates pushed by a collector in each repository, one listing across enrolled projects, and decisions delegated to the approval service.
completed_work: proposal.md, design.md (D1-D10), tasks.md, two spec deltas, contracts/README.md, work-packages.yaml
Planned inline in the sequential tier; discovery questions and plan review were not run because the item was operator-approved at scaffold time

decisions.title: The repository pushes a whole snapshot
decisions.rationale: The coordinator cannot read a checkout; a full replacement makes the projection rebuildable and leaves the repository as the only record.

decisions.title: Degraded state is computed at read time
decisions.rationale: A project with no snapshot, a stale one or source errors must be visible, and its last known gates still listed, without a background job.

decisions.title: Decisions go through the approval service only
decisions.rationale: The projection must never become a second decision record; a gate with no pending approval request is refused with the command that answers it in its repository.

decisions.title: Contract authored in the promoted tree
decisions.rationale: The coordinator's OpenAPI contract test reads only openspec/contracts, and its drift baseline must not grow.
